entry_contract: Qualified ordinary C++ void API: actual receiver, late volatile incoming Node cell, caller-owned live compatible eight-byte raw guard prefix, and actual F00F878CC/M01090AA0 volatile publication cells. Capture returned owner+4 K once; raw guard profile/K and SDK Enter/current modulo depth; late Node capture and oldParent; logically arm; same-parent skip or actual unlink through a new volatile captured-Node word; ordered signed stable insertion with fresh alias-sensitive loads; captured-K normal decrement/Leave and logical disarm. Private noexcept failure control invokes sole actual Source31 raw-guard destroy using current guard+4, retaining partial effects and possible repeated decrement if normal Leave throws. No inferred full layout, fake globals, Native frame, validation or rollback.

indexed_public_graph.method: Every relocation resolves through its physical symbol-table INDEX and auxiliary fallback records, never a same-name guess

limits: The C++ API is not Original ECX/one stack-cell/RET4 binary ABI; it passes explicit actual guard and publication cells.

Native EH state zero follows Node/oldParent reads. Current emitted C++ EH state zero precedes getter and armed flag true is hoisted before those raw reads. Hardware faults, asynchronous fault handling and frame/state timing equivalence are unproved.
Normal C++ disarm/destructor are optimized away. The failure flag remains true through Leave and normal FS restoration, and no normal raw-guard destroy is called.

Source private control at EBP-14h is pointer plus bool; Native EBP-14h is raw profile plus K. Same offset is not frame/type equivalence. Source funclet invokes its private destructor, which calls the real raw-guard provider; Native action tails directly to Original00411EE0.
No exception was executed through the admitted naked Source unlink child; C++ EH metadata and policy have static evidence only.
Current guard+4 failure lookup can differ from captured K after compatible aliases; partial stores/decrements remain, with no rollback, free, unregister or repair.
Backing, volatile typed-view alignment/lifetime/alias domain, actual child preservation, SDK/import/CRT bindings and Original exception interpreter remain qualified.
No production consumer or forced retention, Original whole-call ABI, startup, gameplay or runtime exception validation.
